assumption_name: Standalone HDFC Ltd non-finance operating expense proxy
evidence_required: HDFC Ltd FY23 standalone audited P&L
rationale: Sum of employee benefits 1025.25 + depreciation 275.86 + other expenses 1118.76; excludes finance cost and ECL.

assumption_name: Duplicate share of standalone operating expense
evidence_required: Function-level overlap map and post-close run-rate
rationale: Small cost synergy pool; avoids applying an industrial overlap ratio to the merged bank cost base.

evidence_required: Control and branch-service requirements
rationale: Assumes much of standalone operating cost is not duplicated or removable.

evidence_required: Post-merger org design and retired systems
rationale: Execution haircut; not a management synergy target.

assumption_name: Market borrowings share of HDFC Ltd borrowings
evidence_required: HDFC Ltd FY23 Q4 earnings call transcript
rationale: Management reported market borrowings (NCDs and CP) at 45% of borrowings.

evidence_required: HDFC Ltd FY23 Q4 earnings call transcript
rationale: Management reported deposits ₹152111cr and 27% of borrowings; total borrowings proxy is derived.

evidence_required: Matched-tenor cost of funds before and after merger
rationale: Outside-in sensitivity; actual margin benefit needs average funding costs and liability maturity mix.

evidence_required: Refinancing schedule and deposit availability
rationale: Assumed share of HDFC Ltd market borrowings replaced by lower-cost bank deposits over time.

evidence_required: HDFC merger investor presentation
rationale: Investor deck states 4% CRR and 18% SLR for bank liabilities; actual net incremental NDTL base needs reconciliation.

evidence_required: Matched mortgage yield and CRR/SLR portfolio yields
rationale: Scenario reflects non-earning CRR and the opportunity-cost gap on SLR; not an observed realised cost.

evidence_required: Liability-level migration and reserve base
rationale: Uses same migrated liability share as funding substitution sensitivity; assumes 22% reserve share for scenario.

evidence_required: Eligible loan classification; ANBC calculation; PSL shortfall and PSLC transaction prices
rationale: Not quantified until actual incremental shortfall and certificate/purchase costs are known.

evidence_required: Pre-merger standalone COGS and SG&A schedules
rationale: Analyst proxy for combined cost pool; replace with audited pre-close category/function schedules.

evidence_required: Function and category overlap analysis
rationale: Ex-post sensitivity range set after the announced target and reported savings were known; not a cited benchmark or out-of-sample estimate.

evidence_required: Category-level procurement and operating model review
rationale: Not all overlap is removable; protect brand investment and service levels.

evidence_required: Implementation plan and realised savings validation
rationale: Execution sensitivity for timing and operational constraints.

evidence_required: SEC 10-Q/10-K integration expense reconciliation
rationale: Multi-year programme cost scenario; spread over three years in NPV calculation.

evidence_required: Management savings milestones and programme timing
rationale: Analyst ramp sensitivity; steady-state reached progressively over years 1-4.

assumption_name: Addressable vendor spend and achieved rate reduction
evidence_required: Spend by vendor/category; contract rates and post-merger invoice comparison
rationale: Qualitative case only; no public spend baseline.

assumption_name: Cost per order reduction attributable to integration
evidence_required: Matched-city/order cohort cost and utilisation data
rationale: Requires matched-city counterfactual.

evidence_required: Enterprise seat-level attach renewals pricing and matched customer cohort
rationale: Requires product attach and counterfactual.
